facts.material: fibrous particulate filter media (assumed textile/nonwoven) in housing
facts.function: replaceable HE particulate filter for a powered air-purifying welding respirator

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 5911 textile articles for technical uses; Section XVI note 1(e) and ch.90 note 1(a) exclude textile technical articles from 8421/9020

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of breathing appliances, but ch.90 note 1(a) excludes textile technical articles
Section XVI note 1(e) excludes textile filtering articles

classification.rationale: N253050 classifies an analogous 3M respirator filter cartridge in 5911.90.0080 because textile filtering media is precluded from 84/90.
